## UnsupportedEvidenceSchema variable

The evidence behind an `unsupported` marker, in one of two forms: every read failed ([UnsupportedReadFailureEvidenceSchema](./core.unsupportedreadfailureevidenceschema.md)<!-- -->), or every value had a kind the declared type does not expect ([UnsupportedKindEvidenceSchema](./core.unsupportedkindevidenceschema.md)<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
UnsupportedEvidenceSchema: z.ZodUnion<
  readonly [
    z.ZodObject<
      {
        source: z.ZodLiteral<'probe'>
        observedAt: z.ZodISODateTime
        bundleId: z.ZodString
        appVersion: z.ZodString
        osVersion: z.ZodString
        sampleSize: z.ZodNumber
        failedReads: z.ZodNumber
        errorNumbers: z.ZodArray<z.ZodNumber>
      },
      z.core.$strict
    >,
    z.ZodObject<
      {
        source: z.ZodLiteral<'probe'>
        observedAt: z.ZodISODateTime
        bundleId: z.ZodString
        appVersion: z.ZodString
        osVersion: z.ZodString
        sampleSize: z.ZodNumber
        observedKinds: z.ZodRecord<
          z.ZodEnum<{
            string: 'string'
            number: 'number'
            boolean: 'boolean'
            date: 'date'
            record: 'record'
            list: 'list'
            reference: 'reference'
            other: 'other'
          }> &
            z.core.$partial,
          z.ZodNumber
        >
      },
      z.core.$strict
    >,
  ]
>
```
